clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 3: journal of the Celo and X Layer binaries (checkpoint, commit, checkpoint_revert, tstore and the TransientStorageChange revert) read in celo-org/revm bd28f94 source
clearedSpotChecks.note: Fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/celo-org/revm/bd28f9420c250df2a5c4a6d8103b51ae06b5c222/crates/context/src/journal/inner.rs: checkpoint (lines 577-585) records log, journal and selfdestruct lengths and increments depth; checkpoint_commit (589-591) only decrements depth; checkpoint_revert (595-614) truncates logs and selfdestructs and reverts journal entries in reverse; tstore (1046-1072) removes the key on zero and journals the previous value only when it changed, with an absent previous value journaled as zero. The entry file the research names as entry.rs is at crates/context/interface/src/journaled_state/entry.rs in that commit (fetched); lines 413-427 remove the key when had_value is zero and reinsert it otherwise. This restores the exact pre-frame value of IS_UNLOCKED_SLOT (src/libraries/Lock.sol:13,19,25) and NONZERO_DELTA_COUNT_SLOT (src/libraries/NonzeroDeltaCount.sol:14-22) after a reverted frame. The research path for entry.rs is imprecise; the content claim holds. The machine code was not run, as the research says.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 4: 2,000 of the model vectors by eth_call with a code override at https://forno.celo.org (0 mismatches), and the same at https://rpc.xlayer.tech and https://rpc.mainnet.arc.io
clearedSpotChecks.note: out/send2000.json and out/arith-celo-0..3.json record 0 mismatches and 0 errors (shards 81000 + 3 x 80999 = 323997 cases). I ran 16 independent edge vectors of my own by eth_call with a code override on each of the three endpoints: MULMOD with modulus 2^256-2, 2^255+1, a 2^128-159 modulus and limb-boundary operands near 2^256-2^64; ADDMOD with overflowing sums; SDIV and SMOD of -2^255 by -1 and by 3; SAR by 255 and 256 of a negative word; SIGNEXTEND at bytes 0 and 30; EXP 3^(2^256-1) and 2^255. All 48 results equal the Python reference. web3_clientVersion returned reth/v2.2.0-74cc8bb (Celo), reth/v2.3.0-f60420a/.../xlayer/v0.0.7 (X Layer) and arc/v1 (Arc), matching the research. As the research says, forno.celo.org also answers from an op-geth build whose image was not read, and the BNB endpoint answers Geth v1.8.2, so the reth-bsc image readings do not describe the client that answers that endpoint.
